name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Fix: federated items never showed up. Materialized items had Path set to a federation:// URI Jellyfin doesn't recognize, so it treated them as missing/offline everywhere - hidden from browsing and from the plugin's own dedup check, which silently recreated a full duplicate set every hour. Items are now identified by a FederationKey provider id instead, with Path left null (true Virtual item). Upgrading auto-cleans any legacy federation:// duplicates on the next sync, no manual steps needed. Also triggers a background sync 5s after server start so items appear without waiting for the first scheduled task.
